payload.text: Claude Usage PR upstream, first (hv's decision 12; vc's brief, 2026-11-17). v1.18's ClaudeUsage/UsageManager.swift names each Keychain item once per run (profileLabels, set when nil and never cleared, lines 311 to 313), and UsageHistoryStore records per item (record(service:)). So when an item's login becomes another account's, the name stays the old account's until a restart, and that item's history, sparklines, forecast and History window mix both accounts. The fix, the smallest that works: resolve the email again when an item's token is not the one its name was resolved with, and keep history per account (the resolved email), carrying each item's existing history over in a way the PR states. Tests beside upstream's own. Where: hv's fork /Users/matts/Devel/forks/claudecodeusage (origin matthewsinclair, upstream richhickson): fetch upstream, branch from upstream's main at v1.18 in a new worktree outside the fork's checkout; the checkout (fix/account-picker, clean) and its branches stay as they are. Build and test in a Desk slot from devbin-vc. Then the title, the body (hv: simple, succinct, bullets and short sentences in basic ASD-STE100 form), the branch and the run go to vc, who puts the text to hv. Nothing pushed and no PR until hv says so.
